ui.unraveling_spells.question.title: Important information
ui.unraveling_spells.question.text:
How to start learning magic? First, you need to choose the schools you want to study. But be careful! Once you've chosen a school, you can't change it without losing your resources. To change schools, you can find the Scroll of Oblivion in dungeons, which can clear your school selection but also erase your learned spells.
How to start learning spells? The most important thing for learning spells is the Spell Scrolls, which can also be found in dungeons or purchased from traders. To put them in your inventory, hold them in your hand and RMB on the Magic Lectern. To remove them from the lectern, hold down the SHIFT key and RMB.
Many things in the lectern's interface can be done faster or explained in more detail by holding down SHIFT
item.unraveling_spells.spell_scroll.desc: Gives you the opportunity to learn spells
item.unraveling_spells.oblivion_scroll.d: Erases your learned schools and spells when used
item.unraveling_spells.oblivion_scroll.u: You have successfully forgotten all your knowledge...
item.unraveling_spells.oblivion_scroll.c: Are you sure you want to erase your learned schools and spells? Use the scroll with the SHIFT key pressed to confirm!
item.unraveling_spells.eldritch_manuscri: Can be used in the Magic Lectern to learn Eldritch spells
jei.unraveling_spells.magic_lectern.desc: The main workstation for learning. Use it to choose magic schools and learn spells with Spell Scrolls
jei.unraveling_spells.spell_scroll.descr: The ancient knowledge contained in the scroll. Using it in Magic lectern will be able to give you 1 learned spell. It can be found in dungeon chests,as well as purchased from mage traders
jei.unraveling_spells.oblivion_scroll.de: It can be found with a rare chance in dungeon chests and at mage merchants. The ability to forget your knowledge of learned schools and spells
